description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing articles within the Coocook project. It includes actions for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting articles, as well as private helper methods for fetching related data and managing associated recipes and dishes.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Article
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing articles, including CRUD operations and related data handling.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list articles, fetching project data, and preparing article and unit data for display.

methods.name: new_article
methods.description: Displays the form for creating a new article.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained method to fetch and stash an article by ID, or detach with not_found.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for an existing article, including units in use.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new article, delegating to update_or_insert.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing article, delegating to update_or_insert.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an article if not used in dishes or recipes, with safety checks.

methods.name: fetch_project_data
methods.description: Private method to fetch default project data such as shelf life, units, and shop sections.

methods.name: dishes_recipes
methods.description: Private method to collect related recipes and dishes linked to the current article.

methods.name: update_or_insert
methods.description: Private method to validate input, update or insert article data, and manage related tags and units.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Private method to redirect to the article index page.
